skill_name: Explain the concept of zero-based budgeting.
workflow: Zero-based budgeting is a budgeting process which requires managers to justify all of their expenses and income. Rather than budgeting based on past performance or previous budget amounts, zero-based budgeting requires all expenses to be justified by the current need for them. This helps to ensure that resources and funds are being used wisely and in the best interests of the business. Additionally, zero-based budgeting helps managers to prioritize their spending.
